notes: Capanda Dam with both concrete wings, four deep spillway chutes, yellow crest machinery, switchyard, downstream generator hall and walled tailrace. The standard raw elevation field samples well below the modeled reservoir surface. The authored terrain review places the water at its estimated shoreline level. The normal runtime water mesh currently uses the lower DEM-derived datum. Gate machinery, individual switchyard equipment, concrete elevations and tailrace water level are visual approximations. The model replaces only its powerhouse and the owned crest bridge. Separate mapped service roads and buildings are retained.
